messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — model-quality-regression detected for tenant AcmeCorp (tenant_id: acme-01). Eval job acme-prod-eval-2026 flagged coherence_score -18% vs baseline after a quant profile rollout to dedicated-us-west-2-acme. Affected: text-generation responses; latency OK.

alex: ack. paging on-call. I'm pulling logs and eval diffs.

maya: oncall here (maya). joining. which model variant?

alex: looks like rwd/gpt-medium-v3 with quant profile q4_0_v2 applied only for Acme dedicated pool. Sampling shows hallucinations and shorter outputs. No API rate spikes.

sam: tagging runtime team. @jordan can you check runtime metrics and kernel selection for that pool?

jordan: on it. I see the pool deployed with tensor-quant path on 4 cards: dedicated-us-west-2-acme. KV cache hit rate unchanged. But token-level logits variance is higher post-quant. grabbing traces.

lina-cs: FYI, I'm on the call with Acme SREs. They reported regressions in customer-facing chatbots starting ~2026-11-05 14:03 UTC. They're frustrated. Asking for ETA on mitigation.

alex: priority: isolate tenant, revert quant profile, or pin to previous model variant. Short mitigation = revert quantization for acme. Longer = rebuild quant profile with eval improvements.

jordan: agree. I can push revert to pool config. Suggest command:```bash
# revert quant-profile for acme
redwoodctl pool update --pool dedicated-us-west-2-acme --set quant_profile=none --force --note "incident revert"
```

sam: before we touch prod, confirm rollback impacts. Reverting removes q4 path so throughput per-card drops ~12% for that pool. Acme has reserved capacity so should be fine.

maya: confirm with CS and oncall. lina-cs, can you get Acme signoff for temporary revert? We should also snapshot current profile.

lina-cs: Acme SRE approved immediate revert. They prefer rollback over degraded outputs.

alex: executing snapshot and revert now. tagging operation logs.```bash
redwoodctl pool snapshot --pool dedicated-us-west-2-acme --out /tmp/acme-profile-snap-1867004321.json
redwoodctl pool update --pool dedicated-us-west-2-acme --set quant_profile=none --force --note "revert due to quality regression"
```

incident-bot: OPERATION STARTED — snapshot 1867004520, revert job 1867004623 created.

jordan: revert job accepted by orchestrator, draining new requests from q4 path, switching kernels. ETA ~3m.

sam: monitoring evals and a small golden prompt set. Lina, keep Acme updated: we'll confirm when sample responses match baseline.

lina-cs: relayed to Acme. they're watching. :pray:

alex: revert applied at 1867005623. rolling checks.

jordan: early indicators: coherence_score trending back up, hallucination rate down. token latencies increased ~9% but within SLA for Dedicated.

maya: can everyone run the quick regression check? link: https://internal.runbook/redwood/quality-checks (acme-prod-eval-2026).

sam: ran checks — pass against baseline thresholds. tagging logs: trace IDs sample [trc-9a2b, trc-9a2c].

lina-cs: Acme confirms responses look normal again. they want a postmortem and timelines.

alex: plan: 1) Hold revert and monitor 24h, 2) Create mitigation branch to repro and fix q4 profile, 3) If new quant profile passes eval canary we can reapply in controlled canary with customer opt-in.

jordan: filing infra ticket for deeper kernel/quant mismatch analysis and profiler traces (infra-#4327).

maya: handoff to next oncall: sam will take care of overnight monitoring. sam, you're up at 08:00 PST handoff.

sam: got it. I'll keep alert thresholds tightened for acme pool and will escalate if metrics move.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigation applied (quant revert) at 1867005623, customer confirmed. Status: mitigated -> monitoring.

alex: thanks team. we'll draft a short incident summary for Acme and schedule postmortem with runtime + ML + CS.

lina-cs: sending immediate notes to Acme + follow-up cadence. they appreciated quick revert.

maya: closing this thread for active paging. leave thread open for postmortem updates. :white_check_mark:
